title: Upper-level outlook to adjoining public open space
text: Where adjoining public open space, dwellings with two or more storeys are to include an upper-level balcony and/or window to a habitable room which overlooks the public open space.

replaces.note: Part C C3.6.2 applied to multiple dwellings only; new for single houses

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: New requirement on any two-storey house on a POS-fronting lot. 'Adjoining' POS is undefined (a road or path between the lot and the POS may or may not count).

verified.note: Page reads 'Where adjoining public open space'; wording confirmed. 'Adjoining' is not defined on the page (a road or path between lot and POS is not addressed).
